g.text: Plan and service URLs provisioned by TV6
Startup on Free; pre-deploy if supported
API HTTPS when SSR calls API
Internal DB access / no secrets in logs
PR checks / main or release tag
Wait for deploy status, then smoke
Target architecture, not evidence of live services. Docker Compose is local only.
No VPS, Caddy or external payment service. No browser/web/CI database credentials.
Free: cold start, shared hour quota, Postgres expires in 30 days, no managed backup.
No Free one-off jobs/shell: migration/export requires reviewed runtime implementation.
A successful deploy-hook response is not a completed rollout; poll status and smoke.
